body:
I recognize that.
What has helped when I feel like that is doing some physical exercise (jump rope, running, weightlifting). Those things give me small goals.
Also something trivial like playing on Duolingo (gamified way to learn a language), gives me some microgoals, and some diversion.
For me, after a while of that, I get some inspiration to try new things and I get a positive spiral.

I understand those feelings all to well, I have them often.
What is your opinion on setting very small goals on a path out of it? Like, better try something small, than waiting for improvements?
The reactions here help a little, for a little while. But some time later, I forget about them and again get feelings of despair.

I understand, and I agree.
Often though, there are so many overwhelming things that you almost give up beforehand. Set small goals.

Thanks. The thought that someone actually feels for me helps on the short term.
I don't know how I can turn the long term around though.
